fields.subject: Expression Debug View
fields.condition: the visited expression node is a parameter reference, a constant, a default-value node, a source debug-info node, or a lambda node, or the renderer must name an unnamed parameter, lambda, or label target
fields.response: render a parameter reference as `$` followed by its declared name or, when the parameter has no name, by a synthetic `varN` built from a per-tree sequential id; render a constant as a quoted string, a quoted char, a bare numeral or boolean literal, a numeral suffixed with its type marker (U, L, UL, D, F, or M) when one applies, `null` for a null value, or `.Constant<Type>(value)` otherwise; render a default-value node as `.Default(Type)`; render a debug-info node as `.DebugInfo(file: startLine, startColumn - endLine, endColumn)`; render a lambda node, at the point it is visited, as `.Lambda name<DelegateType>` and enqueue that lambda node for its own parameter-list-and-body definition exactly once, even when the same node is visited again later, preserving first-encounter order across the whole rendering; and assign any unnamed lambda or label target a synthetic `#LambdaN` or `#LabelN` name built the same per-tree sequential way, quoting a declared name that itself contains whitespace
